caption:
Reliance on Allah starts with this one truth

Allah reminds all people who truly needs whom. Begin your morning by asking Him for what you need, big or small.

Surah Faatir 35:15

Name one thing you will ask Allah for this morning.

#relianceonallah #tawakkul #surahfatir #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: O people, it is you who are in need of Allah, whereas Allah is the Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy (Surah Faatir 35:15)
theme: reliance on Allah / we are the ones in need of Him
